The Department of Justice has begun an antitrust investigation of the NFL over its rights deals. This is a HUGE story in sports media. The NFL has a limited antitrust exemption that is in danger of repeal. wsj.com/sports/football/nfl-…
We could, and maybe should, seize all Iranian flagged ships, take the oil, and sell it ourselves.

Megan Rapinoe says it’s hateful to keep men pretending to be women out of women’s sports. Truth: she wouldn’t have had a career in sports if this actually occurred. Mediocre male soccer players are infinitely better at soccer than she is. She’s a moron.

Video
Any media outlet saying that Iran “controls” anything is factually incorrect. They are threatening terrorism, which is actually an illustration of how little control they actually have.

Iran needs to be able to sell and ship its oil to have any semblance of an economy. So far we have allowed that to occur. But we could block the entire strait and not allow any Iranian ships out. That’s what control actually looks like. And we have it. Not Iran.

Iran doesn’t “control” the Strait of Hormuz, they are simply threatening to blow up ships there. Something the US and dozens of other countries could also do. So far we have allowed Iran’s oil to leave the strait. We could stop that immediately. And maybe we should.

Murders are down 68%, 68%!, this year compared to last year in Washington, DC. All since President Trump surged resources in the city. If we can drive down murders like this in DC and Memphis, we can do it nationwide. High crime rates are an awful choice.

Video

You guys know I’ve owned @Braves stock for a while & love its long term value, but @BravesVisionTV is a gold mine. I don’t think they’re getting enough credit for the product they’ve made here or the long term value this direct relationship with fans is going to create for them.

Hopefully there will be a chapter in this book — which someone else will write and no one will read — explaining how Colin Kaepernick can simultaneously believe the NFL Draft is slavery and also why he is so desperate to be a slave and play in the NFL again.


The New York Times (@nytimes)

From @TheAthletic: Ten years after Colin Kaepernick first drew national attention for taking a knee in protest during the national anthem, he is set to tell his life story in a memoir titled “The Perilous Fig

No online sports bets in Ohio is insane. Is it 1986? The result is twofold: 1. people will cross state lines to place sports bets, meaning tax dollars go to states that border Ohio instead of Ohio, or 2. even more people will go to offshores, which also crushes revenue.


Morgan Trau (@MorganTrau)

NOW: Ohio Republican lawmakers are introducing two different bills to overhaul the sports gaming/gambling system:

- No online bets
- Ban on in-game, prop and parlay bets
- Limits wagers to $100
- No

The Democrat party has lost men and is desperately flailing to find new online voices. But that isn’t working. The latest test case, Michigan. I discussed with @HARRISFAULKNER.

Video
